harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and applied login-session resource limits (8192 open files, 256 processes) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified via a real login shell (su -l), then restarted node1 with the mandatory evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and account/limits state, issued a self-acknowledging reboot, confirmed the node was briefly unreachable, polled until it came back, proved the boot_id changed (8660e8f0... -> 656b844c...), and re-verified the appworker account, limits config, and enforced ulimit values post-restart.
actions_performed: Checked appworker did not already exist and confirmed sudo access on node1
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256
Verified enforced limits in an actual login session via su -l appworker
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, account and limits config
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' so the acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Confirmed node briefly unreachable (connection refused) during restart
Polled until node1 came back and captured new boot_id proving restart
Post-restart verification of account, limits config, and enforced ulimits via login shell

evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing appworker user, then created it with useradd -m and verified uid/gid assignment.

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d config with nofile/nproc limits and confirmed the actual ulimit values (8192, 256) inside a real login shell for appworker.
Captured boot_id, uptime, and confirmed appworker account and limits config present before restart.
Backgrounded shutdown -r now so REBOOT_ACK was returned to the caller before the node dropped.

evidence.requirement: Node restart / changed boot identity proof
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable immediately after the reboot command, then came back with a new boot_id (8660e8f0... -> 656b844c...), proving an actual restart occurred.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of account and limits
evidence.summary: After restart, appworker account and limits.d config still present, and su -l login session still enforces ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256.
